reviews.text: Really easy to use and sticks very well to the skin. It stays in place for hours and helps protect my spots without feeling uncomfortable. The patches are also thin and convenient for everyday use. Great value for 90 patches!
reviews.zh: 真係好易用，貼得好穩。可以貼住幾個鐘都唔郁，幫我保護痘痘，又唔會覺得不舒服。貼片都好薄，日常使用好方便。90 塊貼，好抵！

reviews.text: Me and my sister’s go to choice when thinking of buying pimple patches since it it absorbs all the nasty gunks and still look invisible to when applying to face. Good for everyday life when covering acne pimples and treating it at the same time.
reviews.zh: 我同我妹妹買痘痘貼嗰陣，首選都係呢款，因為佢可以吸收晒所有髒嘢，貼喺面上又睇唔到。日常生活入面，一邊遮蓋暗瘡，一邊又可以同時處理，好啱用。

reviews.text: Very effective! I use this whenever I have a breakout and it helps cover up my pimples and pops it after a couple of hours. What I love about it is it seems to blend with my skin so it's not very noticeable
reviews.zh: 好有效！我每次長暗瘡嗰陣都會用，幫手遮住粒痘，幾個鐘頭之後粒痘會冒頭爆開。我最鍾意嘅係佢似乎會同皮膚融合，所以唔會好明顯。

reviews.text: I am using Heartleaf Acpair Spot Patch for many years. It works very well especially when I have papule acne. It helps my acne shrinks without popping or it helps the whitehead come out easily. It’s invisible when wearing it under the makeup. Don’t forget to patch it on your dry face before using any skincare products, it will be very long lasting!
reviews.zh: 我用 Heartleaf Acpair Spot Patch 好多年。特別係有丘疹型痘痘嗰陣，效果好好。佢幫我痘痘縮細，唔使爆開，又或者幫白頭痘容易咁浮出嚟。化妝時放喺底妝下面都睇唔到。記住要喺皮膚乾爽時先貼，之後先用其他護膚產品，咁效果就會更持久！

reviews.text:
The packaging is quite special compared to other brands, as it comes with several individually sealed non-visible patches, which makes it more hygienic and convenient to carry around. The patches are very thin and almost invisible on the skin, so they’re great to use when going out. Once applied, they feel like nothing and are very comfortable to wear throughout the day.

I’m not completely sure how effective they are in treating acne, but they work well as a protective layer to avoid touching the area and prevent infection. Overall, a good option for daytime or outdoor use.
reviews.zh:
包裝同其他品牌相比好特別，有幾塊獨立密封、唔易見嘅貼，所以更加衛生，攜帶都方便。貼片好薄，貼喺皮膚上幾乎睇唔到，所以出街用好啱。貼咗之後幾乎冇感覺，成日戴都好舒服。

我唔係好肯定佢對治療暗瘡有幾大效果，但係佢可以當作保護層，避免觸碰患處，防止感染。整體嚟講，係日間或者外出使用嘅好選擇。

reviews.text: The adhesion isn't great but it was the fastest patch I've used that isn't a microdart. Normally I need a day or two for a patch to work but this worked overnight. Had to put a bandaid over though for extra adhesion.
reviews.zh: 貼力唔算好，但係係我用過最快嘅貼，但唔係微針款。通常一貼就要一兩日先見效，但呢款一晚就見效。我要再蓋一塊 bandaid 先貼得穩陣。

reviews.text: Super thin spot patch, almost invisible to eyes. With 2 sizes that can help cover different acnes. I always use it before doing my makeup. It will be invisible after covering it up with foundation and face powder.
reviews.zh: 超薄嘅痘痘貼，近乎肉眼睇唔到。有兩種尺寸，可以幫助遮蓋唔同嘅痘痘。我每次化妝前都會用。用粉底同散粉蓋住之後，就會睇唔到。

reviews.text: Great for covering a spot to avoid touching it. Very thin and lays very flat. However, I did not notice much improvement in healing spots with these patches
reviews.zh: 用嚟遮蓋痘痘，避免用手摸，非常好。好薄，貼得好平。不過，用呢啲貼之後，我冇見到痘痘癒合有太大改善。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
